about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Saint Joseph, Spouse of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Be with us, we beseech You, O merciful God, and by the intercession of blessed Joseph, Your Confessor, graciously keep safe the gifts You have given us. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
